assertions.text: Does not claim to invoke plugin-lifecycle-downstream's Phase 8 directly with the Conception Brief's own path, in a standalone run
States that Phase 8 requires a findings-bundle (Finding/Report-Revision schema per plugin-rulebook/references/evidence-schema.md, with a baseline_commit), not the brief itself
States it stops rather than attempting the invocation, since no orchestrator is present in a standalone run to perform the findings-bundle conversion
